RoomsCreateFirst: Choose a room type, invite the people you work with and add your files. You're ready to start working together.
RoomsEmpty: The rooms in this tour were examples. Rooms you're invited to will appear here, ready for you to work in.
RoomsEmptyTitle: Your list is empty for now
RoomsGroups: Group related rooms to find them faster. Select rooms to create a group, then switch between groups above the list.
RoomsMembers: Use the Info panel to see room members and their roles. If you can manage members, invite people and choose the access each of them needs.
RoomsPlacesArchive: {{archive}} — rooms set aside from active work. Restore them when you need them again.
RoomsTemplates: Save a room as a template to reuse its settings, folders and files. Create a new room from it, then check its members and access before you start working.
